transcript.text: You studied B.A. Economics (Hons) with 69% till semester 5. What motivated you to choose this field and how has your interest evolved so far?

I'm finishing BA Economics at a government college in Jodhpur. I run the 800 metres and won silver at the state meet in 2024. Last year I captained our college team and organised daily 6 a.m. training for 18 athletes. For a term paper I studied onion prices at the local mandi over 18 months using public data. I want an MBA because sports taught me discipline, and economics gave me theory. I'd like the practical side of running an organisation.

You mentioned your term paper analyzing onion prices at the local mandi using public data. Could you explain one economic concept or theory that was central to this study and how it helped you understand the price changes?
transcript.anchor_quote: For a term paper I studied onion prices at the local mandi over 18 months using public data
